recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-close portrait of a man in a tan western-style shirt against a heavily distressed, light-blue weathered wall. The composition features bold, stacked slab-serif typography at the bottom, utilizing a high-contrast color palette of black and white against the muted background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed off-camera to create a sense of contemplation.
Contrast between the smooth skin tones and the rough, scratched texture of the background.
Heavy typographic weight anchoring the bottom third of the frame.
coreInvariants: Distressed wall texture with dark grit and scratches.
Tan/ochre shirt color providing warmth against a cool background.
Stacked text alignment with the top line significantly larger than the bottom.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, shown from the waist up, filling the middle vertical two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bold black display text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows the line of the shirt down to the bold typography, then moves to the textured negative space.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space to the left and right of the subject, filled with industrial distress patterns.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the text and the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and color contrast within the same typeface family or similar slab-serif styles.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif geometry and blunt terminals.
Provides the necessary weight and industrial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium-close portrait of a middle-aged man with a short beard and bald head, wearing a tan cotton western shirt with double chest pockets. He is looking off to the side. The background is a light blue-grey wall with heavy industrial distress, scratches, and dark grit textures concentrated at the edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered uppercase text at the bottom. The top line should be a very large, heavy black slab-serif. The second line should be a smaller, bold white slab-serif with wider tracking, placed immediately below the first line.

verificationChecks: Is the background texture sufficiently gritty and weathered?
Is the top text line significantly heavier than the bottom line?
Does the subject's shirt color contrast warmly against the cool wall?
Is the text centered and positioned in the lower third?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the tan shirt
Tracking width of the subtitle text
Vertical position of the text block
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or titles
Specific facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and negative space

postGenerationChecks: Check that the slab serifs are thick and rectangular.
Ensure the grit texture does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the black and white text colors are solid and distinct.
Confirm the western shirt details (pockets, stitching) are visible.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a contemplative portrait in earth tones with a heavily distressed industrial background and anchor the base with stacked, high-weight slab-serif typography.
